title: 12 Best Rooftop Bars in Tbilisi — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best rooftop bars in Tbilisi — curated from Reddit reviews. Oxygen Bar, Art-Cafe HOME, Rolling Stone Rooftop Bar, Lolita, Weather Report Sky Bar & more.

places.name: Oxygen Bar

redditQuotes.text: Oxygen Bar was Tbilisi's first rooftop lounge when it opened — and still commands some of the most spectacular views in the city.
redditQuotes.source: — The Culture Trip · Best Bars in Tbilisi guide, 2025

redditQuotes.text: Great rooftop bar with the view of whole Tbilisi. Magi can make the best cocktails in all around Tbilisi. Atmosphere is so cozy, views are incredible.

places.verdict: Tbilisi's original and most iconic rooftop bar — 360-degree views from the 18th floor of the Radisson Blu Iveria over the Old Town, Mtkvari River, and the Caucasus Mountains.

comparison.best for: First-timers wanting the definitive Tbilisi panorama with a cocktail in hand
comparison.strengths: 360° views · 18th floor · iconic location on Rose Revolution Square · excellent Georgian wine list
comparison.what to order: Georgian amber wine or a chacha-based cocktail — the wine list showcases excellent local producers. The view is the main course.
comparison.insider tip: Arrive 30 minutes before sunset for the best light on Narikala Fortress. Non-hotel guests welcome.

places.whatToOrder: Georgian amber wine or a chacha-based cocktail — the wine list showcases excellent local producers. The view is the main course.
places.editorialSummary: Tbilisi's original and most iconic rooftop bar — 360-degree views from the 18th floor of the Radisson Blu Iveria over the Old Town, Mtkvari River, and the Caucasus Mountains.
places.bestFor: First-timers wanting the definitive Tbilisi panorama with a cocktail in hand

redditQuotes.text: Tetto Rooftop bar area — but also Art-Cafe HOME for the best fortress views in the city.

places.verdict: Named one of Europe's hottest rooftop bars by The Guardian. An intimate, artistic terrace with direct views of Narikala Fortress and the Old Town — the kind of place that defines a trip.

comparison.best for: Sunset drinks with a direct Narikala Fortress backdrop in an artistic, bohemian atmosphere

comparison.what to order: Georgian natural wine paired with khachapuri. The food here is also excellent — come hungry.
comparison.insider tip: The terrace is small — arrive early on weekends or you'll be dining indoors.

places.whatToOrder: Georgian natural wine paired with khachapuri. The food here is also excellent — come hungry.

places.name: Rolling Stone Rooftop Bar

redditQuotes.text: Visit the first-ever Rolling Stone rooftop bar. Experience world-class mixology, live music, and the best panoramic views of the Tbilisi skyline from the top.

places.verdict: The world's first Rolling Stone-branded rooftop bar, perched atop the Telegraph Hotel on Tbilisi's main boulevard. Live music, world-class mixology, and panoramic views of Rustaveli Avenue.

comparison.best for: Music lovers and cocktail enthusiasts wanting a premium rooftop experience
comparison.strengths: Rolling Stone brand · live music · Telegraph Hotel location · premium cocktails
comparison.what to order: Signature Rolling Stone cocktails featuring Georgian chacha and local botanicals. The menu changes seasonally.
comparison.insider tip: Only open Friday–Sunday evenings. Book ahead for weekend nights — it's the hottest new opening in Tbilisi.

places.whatToOrder: Signature Rolling Stone cocktails featuring Georgian chacha and local botanicals. The menu changes seasonally.
places.editorialSummary: The world's first Rolling Stone-branded rooftop bar, perched atop the Telegraph Hotel on Tbilisi's main boulevard. Live music, world-class mixology, and panoramic views of Rustaveli Avenue.
places.bestFor: Music lovers and cocktail enthusiasts wanting a premium rooftop experience

places.name: Lolita

redditQuotes.text: Lolita — great cocktails and the Stamba Hotel complex is stunning. One of the coolest spots in Tbilisi for drinks.
redditQuotes.source: — r/tbilisi · Tbilisi Nightlife and Bar Recommendations thread, 2025

places.verdict: Part of the design-forward Stamba Hotel complex, Lolita's elevated terrace and industrial-chic interior draw Tbilisi's creative class. The cocktail program is serious and the atmosphere is effortlessly cool.

comparison.best for: Design-conscious travelers wanting to see Tbilisi's creative scene at its best
comparison.strengths: Stamba Hotel complex · 3,987 reviews · excellent food · terrace seating · locally beloved
comparison.what to order: The cocktail menu features Georgian ingredients. Try a chacha sour or the seasonal specials. The food menu is excellent — order small plates to share.
comparison.insider tip: Walk through the Stamba Hotel lobby first — the brutalist-meets-botanical interior design is worth the visit alone. The rooftop terrace is accessible from the hotel.

places.whatToOrder: The cocktail menu features Georgian ingredients. Try a chacha sour or the seasonal specials. The food menu is excellent — order small plates to share.
places.editorialSummary: Part of the design-forward Stamba Hotel complex, Lolita's elevated terrace and industrial-chic interior draw Tbilisi's creative class. The cocktail program is serious and the atmosphere is effortlessly cool.
places.bestFor: Design-conscious travelers wanting to see Tbilisi's creative scene at its best

places.name: Weather Report Sky Bar
places.address: 37M Ilia Chavchavadze Ave, Pullman Tbilisi Axis Towers, Tbilisi 0179

redditQuotes.text: Enjoy exquisite cocktails and breathtaking city views at Weather Report Sky Bar in Tbilisi. An ideal place for an evening out.
redditQuotes.source: — madloba.info · Top Rooftop Bars in Tbilisi guide, 2025

places.verdict: Tbilisi's highest rooftop bar, perched atop the Axis Towers — one of the city's most striking modern buildings. The views extend across the entire city and into the Caucasus foothills on clear days.

comparison.best for: Visitors wanting Tbilisi's highest vantage point with modern luxury
comparison.strengths: Highest bar in Tbilisi · Axis Towers architecture · panoramic views · daily opening
comparison.what to order: Craft cocktails featuring Georgian botanicals. The wine list is strong on local qvevri wines.
comparison.insider tip: Open every day from 5 PM — ideal for sunset drinks any night of the week. The Vake neighborhood below is worth exploring before or after.

places.whatToOrder: Craft cocktails featuring Georgian botanicals. The wine list is strong on local qvevri wines.
places.editorialSummary: Tbilisi's highest rooftop bar, perched atop the Axis Towers — one of the city's most striking modern buildings. The views extend across the entire city and into the Caucasus foothills on clear days.
places.bestFor: Visitors wanting Tbilisi's highest vantage point with modern luxury

places.name: ATI Rooftop Restaurant

redditQuotes.text: ATI is a Rooftop Restaurant, bar and lounge located on the 10th floor, boasting idyllic views of the city. Serving modern interpretations of Georgian cuisine.

places.verdict: Perched on the 10th floor of the Sheraton Grand Metechi Palace with sweeping views over the Mtkvari River and Old Town. The restaurant-bar hybrid serves modern Georgian cuisine alongside excellent cocktails.

comparison.best for: A refined dinner-and-drinks experience with Old Town and river panoramas
comparison.strengths: 10th floor elevation · Sheraton heritage · modern Georgian cuisine · river views
comparison.what to order: Modern interpretations of Georgian classics paired with Georgian wine. Try the tasting menu if you're dining, or visit just for cocktails at the bar.
comparison.insider tip: The Metechi Palace sits on a cliff above the river — the east-facing terrace gets beautiful morning light if you visit for brunch.

places.whatToOrder: Modern interpretations of Georgian classics paired with Georgian wine. Try the tasting menu if you're dining, or visit just for cocktails at the bar.
places.editorialSummary: Perched on the 10th floor of the Sheraton Grand Metechi Palace with sweeping views over the Mtkvari River and Old Town. The restaurant-bar hybrid serves modern Georgian cuisine alongside excellent cocktails.
places.bestFor: A refined dinner-and-drinks experience with Old Town and river panoramas

places.name: Iveria Cafe

redditQuotes.text: Iveria Cafe — 4.8 stars, 1,057 reviews. One of the best views in Tbilisi and genuinely good food at reasonable prices.
redditQuotes.source: — TripAdvisor · #1 Restaurant with a View in Tbilisi, 2025

places.verdict: TripAdvisor's #1-rated restaurant with a view in Tbilisi. An elevated terrace cafe at the base of Rose Revolution Square with a panoramic sweep over the city — more accessible and affordable than the hotel rooftops above it.

comparison.best for: Daytime drinks and people-watching with a view at an accessible price point
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 1,556 reviews · TripAdvisor top-rated · affordable · central location
comparison.what to order: Georgian wine by the glass, fresh-squeezed lemonade with tarragon (tarkhun), or a Turkish coffee. Simple but well-executed.
comparison.insider tip: Come for afternoon coffee and stay for sunset — the terrace catches beautiful evening light.

places.whatToOrder: Georgian wine by the glass, fresh-squeezed lemonade with tarragon (tarkhun), or a Turkish coffee. Simple but well-executed.
places.editorialSummary: TripAdvisor's #1-rated restaurant with a view in Tbilisi. An elevated terrace cafe at the base of Rose Revolution Square with a panoramic sweep over the city — more accessible and affordable than the hotel rooftops above it.
places.bestFor: Daytime drinks and people-watching with a view at an accessible price point

places.name: Fabrika

redditQuotes.text: Fabrika — you've probably come across this one in your research. A loooot of fun, great vibes, multiple bars and food spots.
redditQuotes.source: — r/tbilisi · Need bar/pub recs from locals thread, 2024

places.verdict: Tbilisi's most iconic social hub — a converted Soviet sewing factory turned cultural center, hostel, and multi-level courtyard bar. The open-air courtyard fills with locals, travelers, and digital nomads every evening. Not a traditional rooftop, but the multi-level terraces qualify.

comparison.best for: Social travelers wanting to meet people in Tbilisi's most vibrant communal space
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 14,564 reviews · most reviewed venue in Tbilisi · affordable · great vibe · multiple bars
comparison.what to order: Local craft beer or cheap Georgian wine. Multiple bars and food stalls to choose from — wander and explore.
comparison.insider tip: The upper terraces are less crowded. Come on a weekend evening for the best atmosphere — it's essentially Tbilisi's communal living room.

places.whatToOrder: Local craft beer or cheap Georgian wine. Multiple bars and food stalls to choose from — wander and explore.
places.editorialSummary: Tbilisi's most iconic social hub — a converted Soviet sewing factory turned cultural center, hostel, and multi-level courtyard bar. The open-air courtyard fills with locals, travelers, and digital nomads every evening. Not a traditional rooftop, but the multi-level terraces qualify.
places.bestFor: Social travelers wanting to meet people in Tbilisi's most vibrant communal space

places.name: Santino

redditQuotes.text: Santino — one of the top rooftops in Tbilisi for coffee and views.

places.verdict: A beloved Old Town rooftop cafe-bar with a sun-drenched terrace tucked among the winding streets near Shardeni. The views over the church domes and clay-roofed houses of Old Tbilisi are intimate and beautiful.

comparison.best for: Lazy afternoon drinks above the Old Town's winding streets and church domes
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 1,504 reviews · charming Old Town location · affordable · excellent coffee and cocktails
comparison.what to order: Georgian wine or a cold brew — Santino straddles the cafe-bar line perfectly. Their pastries are also excellent.
comparison.insider tip: The rooftop is listed on Instagram by @tbilisi_living as one of the top rooftops in the city. Grab a table early on sunny days.

places.whatToOrder: Georgian wine or a cold brew — Santino straddles the cafe-bar line perfectly. Their pastries are also excellent.
places.editorialSummary: A beloved Old Town rooftop cafe-bar with a sun-drenched terrace tucked among the winding streets near Shardeni. The views over the church domes and clay-roofed houses of Old Tbilisi are intimate and beautiful.
places.bestFor: Lazy afternoon drinks above the Old Town's winding streets and church domes

places.name: Baho

redditQuotes.text: Baho — listed as one of the top rooftops in Tbilisi for good reason. Great coffee, nice terrace, local vibe.
redditQuotes.source: — @tbilisi_living · Instagram · Top Rooftops in Tbilisi list, 2024

places.verdict: A neighborhood rooftop gem on Kazbegi Avenue — less touristy than Old Town options, with a relaxed vibe and views over Tbilisi's residential Vake district. Popular with locals for daytime coffee and evening drinks.

comparison.best for: Escaping the tourist areas for a genuine neighborhood rooftop experience
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · local crowd · affordable · daytime terrace · Kazbegi Ave neighborhood vibe
comparison.what to order: Specialty coffee during the day, Georgian wine in the evening. The pastries are house-made.
comparison.insider tip: Closes at 8 PM — this is a daytime/early evening spot, not a late-night bar. Perfect for sunset coffee.

places.whatToOrder: Specialty coffee during the day, Georgian wine in the evening. The pastries are house-made.

places.name: Meoba Bar

redditQuotes.text: My favorite is Politika bar just for Friday drinks. They have very delicious cocktails. Meoba bar is also good.
redditQuotes.source: — r/tbilisi · Gimme the best bar/nightclub you've ever been to in Tbilisi thread, 2024

places.verdict: A favorite among Tbilisi's bar-hopping locals, Meoba serves creative cocktails on its outdoor terrace. The vibe is relaxed and unpretentious — a genuine neighborhood cocktail bar with terrace seating.

comparison.best for: Cocktail lovers wanting a local bar with terrace seating and creative drinks
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 673 reviews · locally loved · creative cocktail menu · terrace · affordable
comparison.what to order: Their signature cocktails featuring chacha and Georgian herbs. Ask the bartender for recommendations — they're knowledgeable and friendly.
comparison.insider tip: Multiple Redditors recommend Meoba as one of the best cocktail bars in Tbilisi period, not just for the terrace. Thursday and Friday nights are liveliest.

places.whatToOrder: Their signature cocktails featuring chacha and Georgian herbs. Ask the bartender for recommendations — they're knowledgeable and friendly.
places.editorialSummary: A favorite among Tbilisi's bar-hopping locals, Meoba serves creative cocktails on its outdoor terrace. The vibe is relaxed and unpretentious — a genuine neighborhood cocktail bar with terrace seating.
places.bestFor: Cocktail lovers wanting a local bar with terrace seating and creative drinks

places.name: Rooms Hotel Rooftop

redditQuotes.text: Rooms Hotel — refined hotel with a chic restaurant. Upscale hotel with a rustic-chic eatery and a trendy bar.

places.verdict: The Rooms Hotel is one of Tbilisi's most design-forward hotels, and its rooftop terrace and bar area offer a refined, intimate drinking experience. The same group operates the Stamba Hotel — this is the quieter, more elegant sibling.

comparison.best for: Design-hotel aesthetics and a refined cocktail in a less-crowded setting than Lolita/Stamba
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 2,838 reviews · Rooms Hotels design pedigree · intimate terrace · excellent bar program
comparison.what to order: The wine list here is curated by a serious sommelier — Georgian natural wines are the star. Cocktails feature local ingredients.
comparison.insider tip: The Rooms Hotel lobby and restaurant are also worth visiting. It's next door to Stamba — do both in one evening.

places.whatToOrder: The wine list here is curated by a serious sommelier — Georgian natural wines are the star. Cocktails feature local ingredients.
places.editorialSummary: The Rooms Hotel is one of Tbilisi's most design-forward hotels, and its rooftop terrace and bar area offer a refined, intimate drinking experience. The same group operates the Stamba Hotel — this is the quieter, more elegant sibling.
